context.notes: Doner meal boxes served with seasoned fries.

semantic.summary: Elegant Levantine restaurant offering Lebanese mezze, charcoal grills, seafood, and shisha in New Zarqa.

Known for old-school skillet-grilled beef burgers served with garlic mayonnaise and cabbage slaw, alongside crispy spicy chicken Zinger wraps, it represents local street fast-food culture.

context.notes: Late night favorite for quick street food bites.

semantic.summary: Authentic Iraqi restaurant renowned for open-fire Masgouf carp fish and traditional grilled skewers.

semantic.summary: Popular fish market restaurant where customers pick fresh seafood to be fried or grilled on demand.

location.address: King Abdullah II Street, New Zarqa

context.notes: Priced by seafood weight before cooking.
